questions.question:
If ‘A’ denotes ‘÷’, ‘B’ denotes ‘×’, ‘C’ denotes ‘+’ and ‘D’ denotes ‘-‘, then what will come in place of the question mark ‘?’ in the following equation?

43 C 80 A 8 D 6 B 5 = ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

43 C 80 A 8 D 6 B 5 = ?

By using the BODMAS rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6607a92e2e2d65c1142117876b706185eaa33ed0ff837d940480af3d3004e7d3.png] 

By, decoding the given symbols we get.

 
 

 SYMBOLS
 MEANING
 
 
 
 

 A
 ÷
 
 

 B
 ×
 
 

 C
 +
 
 

 D
 -
 
 

Substituting the given operator in the given expression:

⇒ 43 C 80 A 8 D 6 B 5

⇒ 43 + **(__80 ÷ 8__)** - 6 × 5

⇒ 43 + 10 - **__6 × 5__**

⇒ **__43 + 10__** - 30

⇒ **__53 - 30__**

⇒ **23**

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 3'.**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it seems to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statements.

**Statements:**

All blinders are curtains.

All curtains are dividers.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some dividers are curtains.

(II) All blinders are dividers.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5bde04379b3810fc75d8779b05033f6cec500ddb320c2e92e0fe0082be23ba4b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee07cd4c455aa185923e3505d87e698ff162cec1625e6a41bf570e42ede814ee.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some dividers are curtains - **True** (Because all curtains are dividers, so the part of dividers that are curtains exists).

II. All blinders are dividers - **True** (Because all blinders are curtains and all curtains are dividers, so all blinders are dividers).

So, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

questions.question: Gaurav ranks 13th from the top and 33rd from the bottom in his class. How many students are there in the class?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Gaurav's rank from the top = 13th

Gaurav's rank from the bottom = 33rd

Total Number of Students = (Rank from Top + Rank from Bottom) - 1

= (13 + 33) - 1

= 46 - 1

**Total Number of Students = 45**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

questions.question:
If + means −, − means ×, × means ÷ and ÷ means +, then what will come in place of question mark (?) in the following equation?

 28 - 19 div 23 + 96 times 3 = ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

28 - 19 ÷ 23 + 96 × 3 = ?

By using the BODMAS rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6607a92e2e2d65c1142117876b706185eaa33ed0ff837d940480af3d3004e7d3.png] 

By, decoding the given symbols we get.

 
 

 SYMBOLS
 MEANING
 
 
 
 

 +
 -
 
 

 -
 ×
 
 

 ×
 ÷
 
 

 ÷
 +
 
 

Substituting the given operator in the given expression:

⇒ 28 - 19 ÷ 23 + 96 × 3

⇒ 28 × 19 + 23 - **(__96 ÷ 3__)**

⇒ **__28 × 19__** + 23 - 32

⇒ **__532 + 23__** - 32

⇒ **__555 - 32__**

⇒ **523**

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

questions.question:

Thus, (12, 72, 6) is the only option follows the same logic.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance from commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statements.

Statements:

All ostriches are crows.

Some ostriches are pigeons.

Some pigeons are sparrows.

Conclusions:

(I) Some crows are pigeons.

(II) Some ostriches are sparrows.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0482d79960b5b0fa3c897a5cf79628e82016d643e001ca59bf7b2f54cc44ab88.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a55efed2e4086348f98a872eb918f8e3a0eb4a1aca0ca9f2f17e71cc8a253fa.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some crows are pigeons - **True** (Because all ostriches are crows and some ostriches are pigeons, so the part of pigeons that are ostriches are also crows).

II. Some ostriches are sparrows - **False** (Because there is no definite relation given between ostriches and sparrows).

So, Only I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4).**
